{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming players and Alexa devices do not address the computer connection needs reflected in my purchases, so none felt useful to me now.",
    "The HDMI cable is loosely related to my DVI cable, but a different connector does not solve the same connection need.",
    "My past headset and tablet mount purchases do not mean I currently need new earbuds or a tablet.",
    "Neither memory card felt relevant because I have no particular device or storage requirement in mind."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronics generally.",
    "Having bought an accessory once seems to have been taken as a reason to buy another related product, without a current need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases repeatedly concern specific connections: WiFi, USB expansion, DVI, and USB to Ethernet. The connection and compatibility matter more to me than simply being an electronic device.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart, and I rarely interact unless something addresses a concrete need; an earlier purchase alone is not enough to make me choose something now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations treated my occasional purchases of practical computer accessories as broad interest in electronics, missing the specific needs behind those purchases."
}
